items.title: Return completed accident questionnaire
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns den ausgefüllten Fragebogen innerhalb von 10 Arbeitstagen (Montag bis Freitag, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 06.05.2026 (private deadline, 'Werktage' here defined by the letter itself as Mon-Fri excluding public holidays). Day of the letter is not counted (§187 Abs.1 BGB). Counting only Mon-Fri, skipping public holidays valid in the recipient's Land NW (§§269, 270 Abs.4 BGB - payer's/obligor's Land): 07.05 Thu=1, 08.05 Fri=2, 09-10.05 weekend skipped, 11.05 Mon=3, 12.05 Tue=4, 13.05 Wed=5, 14.05 Thu = Christi Himmelfahrt (Ascension Day, nationwide holiday) - skipped, 15.05 Fri=6, 16-17.05 weekend skipped, 18.05 Mon=7, 19.05 Tue=8, 20.05 Wed=9, 21.05 Thu=10. The 10th working day is Thursday 21.05.2026, which is not itself a weekend/holiday, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: This deadline (21 May 2026) has already passed relative to today's date (25 September 2026); if the questionnaire was not sent, contact the insurer promptly as delay could affect the liability assessment.
